title: Persist respond arguments through every execution runner
body: The respond tool carries a terminal answer in tool-call arguments, not necessarily streamed tokens. Normal executions and continuations must share one assistant-row resolver; otherwise a reload sees only [tool calls] and Research snapshot recovery loses the final answer.

title: The effective daemon bind is decided by a three-layer default, not the CLI flag
body: DiscoveryConfig's default_expose_to_lan feeds AppSettings' serde default, the settings-load-error fallback, and mDNS gating; a CLI --host value is overridden by settings-backed resolution in both directions. Flip defaults at the defining layer, then sync README/SECURITY/main.rs docs and any pinned tests that assert the old default — and check secondary consumers like Docker entrypoints that pass --host expecting it to win.

title: e2e screenshot specs rewrite committed evidence binaries on every run
body: session-shell.ui.spec.ts overwrites docs/specs/desktop-session-shell/{desktop,narrow}.png each run, leaving the tree dirty against committed evidence. Commit the refreshed pair after suite runs touching them (or repoint the spec at the owning spec dir) so 'read-only cohort' dispositions stay truthful.

title: Origin==Host equality cannot prove locality on a loopback service
body: Under DNS rebinding both Host and Origin echo the attacker's hostname, so a loopback-bound gateway must additionally require the Host authority (port stripped, brackets IPv6-only, numeric-port guard) to be localhost or a loopback literal for Origin-bearing requests.
